significance: An east-facing Shiva temple at Parippu in Aymanam panchayat, Kottayam district, whose present structure is dated to 825 CE and which is counted among the 108 Shivalayas of Kerala. It is administered by the Travancore Devaswom Board. Note: the article's coordinate (9.6197, 76.4771) is used here in place of the Wikidata point about 7 km away.
story: Tradition explains the temple's two Balikkalpuras, unique in Kerala, as the work of two rival rajas who each built their own frontage so as never to meet the other.
